test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, four letter-number pairs are given. The letter-number on the left side of (-) is related to the letter-number on the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three pairs are similar on the basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the number into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/baed4c0a114300cd9b94a14ce4e0a3f54db8b15e9719ddf1652ccdcead2b0276.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-number cluster pair follows the pattern: Letters -5, -5 and Number +210

1. AC293 - VX503

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fde2715ff662803839725927e25f75064d1b7c32d317cda7d0530edfddfa420.png] 

 

This letter-number cluster pair follows the pattern -5, -5, +210.

 

2. EG307 - ZA517

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d9417bc17273e0bdc52f7d3c3e4c8ebf48de7d9d6c718efa13a05d7c2e8b891.png] 

 

This letter-number cluster pair does not follow the pattern -5, -5, +210.

 

3. FT511 - A0721

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c57fa01e9142ead870ec739baf6b4d76ab1921a852a8a26b1fa7bbbc5bd38145.png] 

 

This letter-number cluster pair follows the pattern -5, -5, +210.

 

4. RB479 - MW689

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e093ce6eed20030b9f548bfed8cd50b512366d6d682955c5e7fe0646b992958a.png] 

 

This letter-number cluster pair follows the pattern -5, -5, +210.

 

Thus, 'EG307 - ZA517' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
